page.overview:
Who is Gelatin Man?

Gelatin Man first appears in "Mystery Train." When the train Finn and Jake are riding in plummets off the edge of the ruined tracks, Gelatin Man breaks the train's fall, saving Finn and Jake's lives.

He is a giant lime-green gelatin person that is large enough to catch a train. He also has large green eyes and his body is in the shape of a gelatin mold.
